title.zh: Kalshi says CFTC hasn’t contacted it over ‘unusual’ $5B trading activity
title.en: Kalshi says CFTC hasn’t contacted it over ‘unusual’ $5B trading activity

current_state.zh: Kalshi said the CFTC has not contacted it and denied wash trading, after the Wall Street Journal reported the regulator was reviewing nearly $5 billion in unusually repetitive Ether perpetual futures trades clustered around $5,500.
current_state.en: Kalshi said the CFTC has not contacted it and denied wash trading, after the Wall Street Journal reported the regulator was reviewing nearly $5 billion in unusually repetitive Ether perpetual futures trades clustered around $5,500.
